reason: Twenty-third pre-release reset (regenerated on 2026-11-17 at 18:14 UTC after the owner re-migrated and re-seeded the development database): the single init migration was regenerated from the current schema to fold in feature flags v2 (enhancement 5.16, ADRs 086 and 087), which until then was the separate 20261117210000_feature_flags_rules_and_experiments migration that no shared database applied: the FlagEntryKind, FlagRevisionStatus, FlagRevisionSource, FlagOverrideUnit, FlagRolloutUnit, FlagGroupKind, FlagDecisionSource and ExperimentStatus enums; the FEATURE_FLAG_GROUP, DYNAMIC_CONFIG and EXPERIMENT permission resources; FlagRevision with its (kind, key, number) unique and its one-LIVE and one-PENDING partial uniques per (kind, key); FeatureFlagKillSwitch; FeatureFlagCatalogVersion; FeatureFlagOverride with live-only uniques per user, branch and merchant; FlagGroup and FlagGroupMember with live-only uniques; the append-only FeatureFlagExposure (unique per (eventId, position)) and its FeatureFlagExposureDaily rollup; Experiment with its live-only key unique and one RUNNING experiment per config; the append-only ExperimentMetricEvent (unique per (eventId, metric)); and ExperimentResult. The v1 FeatureFlagSetting and FeatureFlagStoreOverride tables and the FeatureFlagMode enum are dropped (rules, overrides and kill switches replace them). All of this sits on top of the twenty-second reset's customer tiers (ADR 085: the CustomerTier and CustomerTierChangeReason enums, Reward.minimumTier, Redemption.customerTier, CustomerTierStanding with its live-only userId unique and its tier and demotionDueAt indexes, the append-only CustomerTierChange with its (userId, occurredAt DESC) index, and CustomerTierSettings keyed by its unique key), the twenty-first reset's Notion docs sync (DocsSyncRun with its runId unique and its (startedAt, id) and (status, startedAt) indexes, the DocsSourceKind, DocsSyncRunStatus and DocsSyncTrigger enums, the DOCS_SYNC permission resource and the NOTION ReceivedWebhookProvider), the twentieth reset's notification attachments (Notification.attachment, InAppNotification.attachment and the NOTIFICATION_DOCUMENT file category), claim holds (enhancement 5.14: RewardClaimHold and its RewardClaimHoldStatus enum and RLS), passkeys (enhancement 1.7: WebAuthnCredential and WebAuthnChallenge, the WebAuthnChallengePurpose and WebAuthnDeviceType enums, and the PASSKEY sign-in methods on SessionSignInMethod), outbound webhooks (enhancement 5.7: WebhookEndpoint, WebhookEvent and WebhookDelivery with the WebhookEndpointStatus, WebhookEndpointDisabledReason and WebhookDeliveryStatus enums and their RLS), the inbound webhook record (enhancement 5.7: ReceivedWebhook with the ReceivedWebhookProvider, ReceivedWebhookVerification and ReceivedWebhookOutcome enums and their RLS), payments (ADR 020: PaymentIntent with its Idempotency-Key unique per tenant, the append-only PaymentEvent history, their enums and RLS), the live-only uniques (Q9: User.email and Location (tenantId, code) unique among rows that aren't soft-deleted), audit-record retention (ADR 078: AuditLegalHold and the append-only RetentionRun), account erasure (ADR 077: AccountErasure and User.erasedAt), the weekly restore drill (enhancement 2.6: the append-only OpsRestoreDrill), the admin user list's order index (enhancement 2.7: User (createdAt, id)), the BACKGROUND_JOB permission resource (enhancement 4.4), the public status page (enhancement 4.5: StatusIncident and the append-only StatusIncidentUpdate, the STATUS_INCIDENT permission resource), saved views on admin lists (enhancement 5.10: SavedListView), pictures in broadcasts (enhancement 5.4: the BROADCAST_IMAGE and PLATFORM_BROADCAST_IMAGE file categories), the FEATURE_FLAG permission resource (enhancement 5.6) and push by Firebase Installation ID (enhancement 5.3: PushDevice.installationIdCiphertext, encrypted at rest). No shared or deployed database has applied the previous baseline or the folded-in migration (nothing is deployed yet), so no data migration is required; existing development databases are re-migrated and re-seeded.
